# Case Western Reserve University

> > A leading research university in Cleveland offering academic programs, medical education through its School of Medicine, and campus news through The Observer.

Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) is a private research institution known for its School of Medicine, University Hospitals partnerships, and departments including Cardiovascular Medicine, Clinical and Molecular Endocrinology, and Gastroenterology. The university serves the Cleveland Heights community and maintains The Observer as its campus publication.
